#!/usr/bin/env python3
import os
import re
import threading
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer

DATA_DIR = "/opt/builder/data"
LOCK = threading.Lock()
ID_RE = re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z0-9_./-]+$")


def safe_path(rec_id):
    # Reject path traversal; ids are simple tokens joined with '/'
    if not rec_id or rec_id.startswith("/") or ".." in rec_id.split("/"):
        return None
    return os.path.join(DATA_DIR, rec_id)


class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    protocol_version = "HTTP/1.1"

    def do_GET(self):
        if self.path == "/health":
            body = b"ready"
            self.send_response(200)
            self.send_header("Content-Type", "text/plain")
            self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
            self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(body)
            return
        if self.path.startswith("/records/"):
            rec_id = self.path[len("/records/"):]
            path = safe_path(rec_id)
            if path is None:
                self._reply(400, b"")
                return
            with LOCK:
                try:
                    with open(path, "rb") as f:
                        data = f.read()
                except OSError:
                    data = None
            if data is None:
                self._reply(404, b"")
                return
            self._reply(200, data)
            return
        self._reply(404, b"")

    def do_PUT(self):
        if self.path.startswith("/records/"):
            rec_id = self.path[len("/records/"):]
            path = safe_path(rec_id)
            if path is None:
                self._reply(400, b"")
                return
            length = self.headers.get("Content-Length")
            if length is None:
                self._reply(411, b"")
                return
            body = self.rfile.read(int(length))
            with LOCK:
                os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(path), exist_ok=True)
                tmp = path + ".tmp"
                with open(tmp, "wb") as f:
                    f.write(body)
                os.replace(tmp, path)
                os.sync() if hasattr(os, "sync") else None
            self._reply(204, b"")
            return
        self._reply(404, b"")

    def _reply(self, code, body):
        self.send_response(code)
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
        self.end_headers()
        if body:
            self.wfile.write(body)

    def log_message(self, *args):
        pass


def main():
    os.makedirs(DATA_DIR, exist_ok=True)
    server = ThreadingHTTPServer(("0.0.0.0", 8080), Handler)
    server.serve_forever()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
